## Overview

This workshop (11th edition) is scheduled for 21–25 September 2026 in Mola di Bari (Italy). The meeting focuses on radiation of high-temperature gases in the context of space missions, covering topics related to radiative properties and high-temperature radiation modeling/analysis in that domain.
